title: IHIT investigating in-custody death
article: The Integrated Homicide Investigation Team is looking into the death of a 37-year-old man after he was arrested by Abbotsford Police.
On Friday afternoon, Christopher Leslie Kampman was reported prowling in the area near Rosewood Drive and Busby Road in Abbotsford.
He was arrested and transported to hospital in serious condition where he died early Sunday morning.
IHIT has been tasked with an independent investigation into Kampman's arrest and death.
Investigators will be trying to determine what the 37-year old was up to in the hours leading up to his arrest.
Anyone with information regarding this case is asked to call the IHIT Tip Line at 1-877-551-IHIT.
